rootRule: Weather Mother opens the original World runtime by default.
navigation: Rain, Snow, Fog, Cloud and Storm remain child modules in the persistent Weather Mother drawer.
worldRule: v110-full is the protected cloud and full weather runtime. This release does not modify it.
rainRule: Liquid Rain V1.2 is attached only under the Rain module.
otherModuleRule: Fog, Snow, Cloud and Storm use existing v110-full cases. No replacement renderer may be introduced without explicit user instruction.
directModuleBehavior: Convenience module paths return to the unified Weather Mother shell with the requested module selected.
